Destination Wealth Management Has Lifted Its Stake in Unilever Plc (UL) by $315,260 as Stock Declined; As Citigroup Com New (C) Share Value Declined, Wall Street Access Asset Management Has Lowered by $585,340 Its Position
May 6, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc decreased its stake in Citigroup Inc Com New (C) by 44.79% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc sold 7,910 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.55% with the market. The hedge fund held 9,751 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $725,000, down from 17,661 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wall Street Access Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Citigroup Inc Com New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $173.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.47% or $0.32 during the last trading session, reaching $67.94. About 12.51 million shares traded. Citigroup Inc. (NYSE:C) has risen 17.06% since May 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 5.51% the S&P500.
